title: 版式（下拉）
description: Page-mode 页面 section: the 版式 dropdown gives the current page a layout. 无版式 sends a null layout, which removes the inherited copies and keeps the page's own content. Disabled while a version is previewed.

kimiUi.location: 右侧属性面板 / 页面 / 版式
kimiUi.appearsWhen: page mode with no element selected

preconditions.notes: Committed as test-fixtures/layouts-project (built by test-fixtures/build-layouts-project.mjs): page 1 封面, pages 2-23 正文, page 24 no layout. Page 5 uses 正文.

steps: 选择「无版式」，或选择「封面」「正文」

pptd.summary: layoutApply writes the page's layoutId; 无版式 writes no layoutId

selfTestChecklist: the 版式 section lists 无版式 and every layout with its page count
choosing 无版式 sends layoutId null; choosing a layout sends its id
